recognize_zh: 細胞密度高的骨髓切片中，只見棕色陽性細胞零星散布於間質，沒有形成緊密聚集；此圖標記未標示，單憑這種散在分布無法滿足系統性肥大細胞增生症的主要標準，需搭配 CD25 與其他切片判讀。
features: Hypercellular marrow with scattered immunoreactive cells
Positive cells distributed singly and in small loose groups in the interstitium
No compact aggregates of positive cells in this field
Positive cells small, round to slightly spindled
describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain (DAB; marker not specified) of a hypercellular bone marrow biopsy shows scattered positive cells distributed singly and in small loose clusters throughout the interstitium. No compact multifocal aggregates are identified in this field. If this represents a mast cell marker, an interstitial increase of mast cells alone does not meet the WHO major criterion, and minor criteria (spindled morphology >25%, CD25/CD2/CD30 aberrancy, KIT D816V, serum tryptase >20 ng/mL) must be evaluated. Findings are suggestive of, but not by themselves diagnostic of, marrow involvement by systemic mastocytosis.

ddx.vs: Reactive mast cells are round, CD25-negative and lack KIT D816V despite an interstitial increase.

ddx.dx: Normal scattered CD117+ progenitors or plasma cells
ddx.vs: CD117 also stains myeloid progenitors, and tryptase or CD25 co-expression is needed to confirm mast cell identity.
Scattered interstitial CD3+ T cells are small round lymphocytes without granular cytoplasm and are tryptase-negative.
